description: Analytics in two tiers: cookieless Cloudflare Web Analytics for everyone, and GA4 or Meta Pixel only after consent. Each one turns on when its env variable is set.
env: # Analytics. Leave a value empty and that service ships nothing.
# Cookieless, no consent needed (Cloudflare dashboard, Web Analytics, add site, JS snippet token):
# Cookie-setting, loaded only after the visitor allows it:

boundaries: Cookie-setting analytics load only after consent (`src/lib/analytics.ts`). Never add a tracker that bypasses it; a new provider gets a file in `config/csp/` and a line in the privacy page.
pitfalls: gtag.js only reads `arguments` objects from `dataLayer`. A rest-parameter array is pushed but never sent; keep the `arguments` push in `initGoogle`.

manual: Set the analytics IDs in `.env` and as build variables on the host, then check in the browser that hits send only after consent.
Write the privacy page (`src/pages/privacy.astro`) naming each service.
